risks.text: bin/run.js imports dotenv and semver at the top, before the Node version check, and runs from dist (enableAutoTranspile false), so a src edit needs a rebuild and old Node can fail before the friendly message - packages/cli/bin/run.js:1-14,38 (history 10e0bd8)

loadDotenvConfig reads .env from the current directory and never overrides variables already set; a stale .env in an unrelated cwd silently supplies an API key and a shadowed key is not warned about - packages/cli/bin/run.js:26-36

`functions dev` secures the runtime routes with a per-run random token in the path prefix, checked by plain startsWith; every new route must sit behind that prefix check, and readJsonBody has no size limit - packages/cli/src/lib/functions/dev.ts:336,482,677 (history ce298c6)

Secret values piped with --stdin keep the trailing newline (`echo foo |` stores "foo\n") and empty stdin gives an empty secret with no refusal, while readStdin for JSON bodies trims - packages/cli/src/lib/secrets/input.ts:17-23 and packages/cli/src/lib/cloud/api.ts:239-250

Local Chrome discovery trusts DevToolsActivePort only after probing /json/version on 127.0.0.1; remote or WSL setups are not found, and removing the probe reconnects to whichever browser owns port 9222 - packages/cli/src/lib/driver/local-cdp-discovery.ts:74,145 (history 514970e)

groups.title: Chrome MV3 extension runtime: JSON-RPC router, CDP page/frame/context layer, act/extract/observe services, domain policy

risks.text: Variable substitution in act is a split/join of %key% over every variable in turn, so a value containing another %key% is substituted again depending on key order, and missing variables stay as literal %key% - packages/extension/services/actService.ts:517-520 (history 1e50db6)

Cross-origin iframe sessions wait in pendingOopifByMainFrame until the frame attaches; the map is cleared on re-init and touched in many places, so edits to attach/detach/adoption can silently drop iframe content from snapshots and act - packages/extension/understudy/context.ts:107,495,825,875,1009 (history 44d99df)

Stagehand init reconnects only when browserCdpUrl differs from the remembered browserSessionCdpUrl, and throws if it is missing and no session is connected; any new path that connects must set/clear browserSessionCdpUrl or a changed CDP URL is silently ignored - packages/extension/runtime.ts:378-400,449-478 (history 113ad81)

Domain policy outlives the Stagehand instance on the shared browser connection unless disposeStagehandInstance clears it; keep that reset when changing disposal or the next instance inherits the old policy - packages/extension/runtime.ts:1088-1090 (history 066e875)

Frame.evaluate injects the function source and JSON.stringify(arg) into an expression string, retries once only on 'Cannot find context with specified id', and checks progress.throwIfStopped between steps; undefined args and non-JSON values are not preserved - packages/extension/understudy/frame.ts:136-180 (history 7d8dcef, 1e3270c)

checks.why: vitest suites that read these fixtures

rules.rule: Never hand-edit packages/sdk-python/src/stagehand/_generated; change schemas.ts, rebuild the protocol, then run `just generate` and commit the output.
rules.why: `just check` compares generated files byte for byte, so CI fails and the Python SDK drifts from the wire contract.

rules.rule: Protocol objects are z.strictObject; adding, renaming or making a field accepted on one side is a wire change that must go through the protocol package and a version bump per CONTRIBUTING.
rules.why: Strict objects reject unknown keys, so an older extension or SDK that receives a new field fails the whole request; the strictness test fails the build if a schema uses a loose object.

rules.rule: Every functions dev runtime route must require the per-run token prefix.
rules.why: otherwise any local process or web page can poll invocations (session connectUrl, secrets) or forge results.

rules.rule: A DevToolsActivePort file must be verified against the live /json/version before use.
rules.why: a port collision connects the CLI to the wrong browser.

rules.rule: The Node engines range in packages/cli/package.json must match the check in bin/run.js, which must run first.
rules.why: users on old Node get cryptic syntax errors instead of the upgrade message.

rules.rule: The extension version must be a valid Chrome version and the build must pass validateExtension before the zip is written.
rules.why: SDKs embed the zip; a bad build throws or ships a broken artifact.

rules.rule: Variables are substituted as %name% tokens at act/replay time, never stored raw in cached actions.
rules.why: cached actions would leak raw values or fail to replay.

rules.rule: Tool contract changes go in packages/integrations/core only.
rules.why: copies in harness packages drift from the contract.

rules.rule: Each integration test file belongs to exactly one group in integrationTestGroups.
Target each stacked PR at its immediate predecessor; after a squash merge of the parent, verify identical trees and merge S^ then S with -s ours.
rules.why: otherwise the child PR diff shows already-merged changes or loses changes.
